actions: Added an addressable project detail route and restored the selected project from route parameters on load and refresh.
Placed the project calendar in the overview right column with the project description below it and preserved responsive stacking.
Increased the plan number column to 230px.
Unified project owner, plan owner, and project member selector labels through userOptionLabel; role and organization selectors already use names.
Replaced the overview description-only panel with labeled project facts and a separate description section beside the calendar.
Changed initialization and route watching so detail URLs load detail data directly and list URLs load the workbench list.
Added contextual loading text and a dedicated detail-route loading placeholder, then promoted the calendar to the overview desktop right column with responsive stacking.
evidence: Frontend build completed successfully before this task moved to observation.
